pcs.pc_description: organize the assigned work area/station efficiently
arrange the correct tools and equipment required to cook the dishes
confirm the cleanliness and proper functioning of the tools and equipment
monitor and ensure appropriate temperature of the appliances to be used
notify the senior chef if there are any faulty or damaged kitchen equipment/tools
distribute the supplies to different workstations in the kitchen
replenish service lines as needed and restock and prepare the workstation for the next shift

modules.module_title: Prepare and cook base items, veg and non-veg dishes

pcs.pc_description: select the type of ingredients required for preparation of the dishes
collect raw food items/ingredients for cooking from the storage area, fridge, or freezer
measure out ingredients for different recipes
confirm the ingredients meet quality standards and other requirements
mix ingredients in correct proportions
prepare ingredients for cooking including seasoning of different meats as well as washing, peeling, and chopping vegetables and fruits
carry out basic preparatory work like mixing or grinding of spices/ingredients, preparing dough, and wrapping food items etc. as per the CDP’s instructions
prepare basic items like sauce, salads, and cold starters, etc. as directed by the Chef de Partie
plate and present meal items as per the Chef de Parties’ instructions
receive and check regular deliveries of fresh ingredients and other delivered goods against invoice for quantity and quality
label all ingredients and prepared items correctly
inform chef/manager about the inventory status and help in re-ordering of supplies
assist in stock rotation to check and use the ingredients before their expiry date
refill kitchen condiment bottles/shakers/oil cans/etc.
store non-distributed provisions, supplies and daily consumables under appropriate conditions as per organisation’s work instructions
assist the chef/manager to plan rotations, if required
keep track of quantity of daily and weekly consumption and stock of supplies/fuel/cooking oil

modules.module_title: Close kitchen at the end of day’s business/shift

pcs.pc_description: store all unused ingredients and prepared food items at the correct location and in controlled environment in compliance with food safety regulations
discard all expired and spoiled food items stored in the stock rooms, refrigerators, and freezers
wash and disinfect kitchen tools, knives and other equipment
check that all appliances are turned off, unplugged, and cleaned as per health and hygiene standards
perform basic cleaning duties and ensure that work stations are properly sanitized
ensure disposal of waste and expired items as per waste management policy and recycling of waste material wherever applicable

pcs.pc_description: arrange wood kindling, paper, and charcoal, as required
apply a light layer of vegetable oil inside the tandoor for dough to stick to it
light a fire at the bottom of the tandoor using wood kindling, paper, and charcoal
place the lid on the oven and keep for at least two hours to make the tandoor ready for use
make dough as per requirements
make Indian bread from the dough as per the size requirements
apply vegetable oil on the bread and place it on a cloth
put the bread inside the tandoor with the help of the cloth and ensure bread sticks to the tandoor wall
take it out with the help of tongs/skewers when the bread is ready
create marinades and rubs
set long skewers threaded with marinated meat/vegetables/cheese or paneer
place the skewer inside the tandoor such that the tip of the skewers rest on the charcoals and the food is suspended in the centre of the oven
take the skewers out when meat/vegetable/cheese or paneer are cooked and ready to eat
ensure cleanliness and sanitation of the tandoor oven before start and end of day’s business
check for any defects in the tandoor oven and inform supervisor/proprietor
clean the tandoor and dispose of fuel residue at the end of day’s business
ensure clay is regularly applied on the tandoor walls for better service
cover the tandoor when not in use to avoid any contamination
